data.one_liner: A Flutter sticky headers and index ListView with an IndexBar for contact and city lists.
data.what_it_does: Provides AzListView, SuspensionView, and IndexBar components for creating contact or city list interfaces grouped A-Z. It supports sticky headers with floating options, custom headers, index linkage, and local images in the IndexBar.
use_when: You need to build an A-Z sorted contact list or city list with a quick-jump index bar.
You require sticky headers that float or stick dynamically while scrolling.
avoid_when: You need a standard lazy-loading list without alphabetic indexing or sticky headers.
strengths: Easy creation of contact and city list interfaces
Supports sticky headers with floating options and custom headers
IndexBar supports custom styles and local images
weaknesses: Limited to list-based UIs with A-Z indexing
